description: NF profile retrieval for a given NF instance currently registered in NRF.

constraints.statement: The NF Service Consumer shall send an HTTP GET request to the resource URI "nf-instances/{nfInstanceId}".
evidence: 1. The NF Service Consumer shall send an HTTP GET request to the resource URI "nf-instances/{nfInstanceId}".
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the required HTTP method and target resource for the operation.

constraints.statement: On success, the NRF shall return 200 OK.
evidence: 2a. On success, "200 OK" shall be returned.
constraints.why_interesting: This is the required success status code for the retrieval operation.

constraints.statement: On success, the response body shall contain the NF profile of the NF instance identified in the request.
evidence: 2a. On success, "200 OK" shall be returned. The response body shall contain the NF profile of the NF instance identified in the request.
constraints.why_interesting: This specifies the required payload content for a successful response.

constraints.statement: If the NF Service Consumer is not allowed to retrieve the NF profile of a specific registered NF instance, the NRF shall return 403 Forbidden.
evidence: If the NF Service Consumer is not allowed to retrieve the NF profile of this specific registered NF instance, the NRF shall return "403 Forbidden" status code.
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the authorization failure behavior and status code.

constraints.statement: If NF Profile retrieval fails at the NRF due to NRF internal errors, the NRF shall return 500 Internal Server Error.
evidence: If the NF Profile retrieval fails at the NRF due to NRF internal errors, the NRF shall return "500 Internal Server Error" status code with the ProblemDetails IE providing details of the error.
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the server-error status code for internal failures.

constraints.statement: If NF Profile retrieval fails at the NRF due to NRF internal errors, the response shall include the ProblemDetails IE providing details of the error.
evidence: If the NF Profile retrieval fails at the NRF due to NRF internal errors, the NRF shall return "500 Internal Server Error" status code with the ProblemDetails IE providing details of the error.
constraints.why_interesting: This specifies the required error details in the response body for internal failures.

constraints.statement: In the case of redirection, the NRF shall return a 3xx status code.
evidence: In the case of redirection, the NRF shall return 3xx status code, which shall contain a Location header with an URI pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance.
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the required class of status code for redirection.

constraints.statement: In the case of redirection, the NRF response shall contain a Location header with a URI pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance.
